summary: Accept bare typed harness nodes and allow selecting the native executable in KDL

schema.detail: No database changes; the existing typed harness grammar gains an optional executable child.

rules.detail: Typed driver protocols, actor authority, authentication and native admission checks remain unchanged.

compatibility.detail: Bare harness nodes now behave like empty bodies for all supported providers. Existing declarations retain their native executable name unless executable is explicitly set.

downtime.detail: No migration or service interruption is required.

manual.detail: Use harness executable to pin an installation or bypass PATH shims. The configuration reference documents login-shell PATH resolution and examples for every provider.

recovery.detail: Remove executable to restore provider-name PATH lookup; no durable data conversion is involved.
